status: post-audit exploratory sensitivity; specified after original results and before this additional calculation
purpose: Assess dependence of the original cohort-level rank contrast on the five included recordings with more than one boundary annotation; not infer whether annotations represent physical acquisition breaks.
selection_rule: Exclude every originally included participant whose versioned target-recording event metadata contain more than one boundary event. Include the pre-support extra annotation as well; do not choose between alternative exclusion lists after seeing results.
retained_schedule: Exact participant rows of original schedule; no replacement or new temporal draws
estimand: Mean over draws of Fisher-transformed across-participant Spearman correlation under ten-stratum distributed sampling minus contiguous sampling
bootstrap_unit: participant; same sampled participant vector for both geometries and all draws/arms
numerical_failure: Report and stop, without clipping, replacement or alternative roster
reporting: Report N, contrast, percentile interval and separately MCSE; include the result whatever its direction. Original primary, prespecified complete-support, replication and exploratory outputs are unchanged.
no_new_claim: No causal decomposition, confirmatory hypothesis, revised registration, new effect threshold or definitive continuity diagnosis
